rounds_where_plurality_differs_from_auth.structural_qualification: This 0/80 is NOT a clean zero and must never be quoted bare (D007 item 2). Cite the sensitivity analysis alongside the zero every time.

sensitivity_to_unrecoverable_intentions.method: adversarial: every unrecoverable role-round assigned the worst-case route (A/B/HOLD), all combinations enumerated
sensitivity_to_unrecoverable_intentions.structured_only_fallback: dropping both free-text roles entirely leaves planner vs executor, which agree in 80/80 rounds; no tie, no difference

clustering_caveat.note: the 80 rounds are nested in 20 trials and are not independent: within a trial nothing changes between rounds, so a trial is effectively one route decision repeated ~4x. Rates are reported at both levels.

findings.headline: 0/80 multi-agent rounds differ between plurality(tie->HOLD) and planner authority; 0/80 route-intention disagreement; 0/80 ties; 20/20 action sequences identical. Rate is exactly 0/80. QUALIFIED (D007 item 2): the instrument cannot record a route intention for 2 of 4 roles (org.py SCHEMAS:20-23); the adversarial sensitivity analysis (0 rounds flip over all A/B/HOLD reassignments of the 14/160 unrecoverable intentions) is what licenses relying on this zero.
findings.legacy_vs_route_intention: legacy org.py:161 disagreement 6/80 = 0.075 of rounds vs route-intention 0/80 = 0.000; absolute gap 0.075. All 6 legacy-True rounds are unanimous on route. UNIT (D007 item 3): cell D disagreement_rounds = 1.0 is a per-trial COUNT (per-trial values [1,2,1,1,0]), not a proportion; as a rate it is 0.25 of rounds.
findings.measurement_validity_finding: 2 of 4 roles (researcher, reviewer) have NO route field in their output schema (falsify/org.py SCHEMAS lines 20-23), so their route intention is never structurally recorded. 146/160 free-text role-rounds could be adjudicated from text; 14/160 (8.75%) could not and were left as null rather than imputed. This is a measurement-validity limitation, not a zero.
findings.policy_F_audit: no round record in data/trials/exp001_pilot.jsonl carries the executor_overridden field; that field postdates this run. Executor compliance (20/20 trials, 80/80 rounds) is confirmed by recomputation (planner plan_route maps to executor action in 80/80), not by a logged override flag. The policy-F override path is therefore unexercised and untested on this data.
findings.exploratory_label: EXPLORATORY per EDGE_CASE_POLICY §K. No hypothesis status change is proposed by this analysis.

unit_clarification_D007_item3.error_being_corrected: cell D `disagreement_rounds = 1.0` has been quoted bare since the 11:10:03 timeline entry and was repeated in decisions/D005.json item 3. Stated bare, '1.0' reads as 100%. It is not.
unit_clarification_D007_item3.what_1.0_actually_is: a PER-TRIAL COUNT: the mean number of flagged rounds per trial. Unit = rounds/trial.
unit_clarification_D007_item3.cell_D_rate_denominator: 5 rounds flagged / 20 rounds (5 trials x 4 rounds)
unit_clarification_D007_item3.correct_statement: The legacy org.py:161 field fires on 6/80 rounds = 0.075 overall, and on 5/20 rounds = 0.25 in cell D (mean 1.0 rounds per trial). Route-intention disagreement is 0/80 = 0.000. The cell means 1.0 (D) and 0.2 (C) reported in results/exp001_pilot.json are COUNTS per trial, not proportions.
unit_clarification_D007_item3.rule_going_forward: never quote disagreement_rounds without its unit; say "1.0 rounds/trial (= 0.25 of rounds)".

declination_scope_D007_item1.nature: a RESOURCE-ALLOCATION call, not a hypothesis verdict. Upheld against its strongest attack in critiques/review_D003.md §2.
declination_scope_D007_item1.scope: applies to exp001_pilot's 80 multi-agent rounds ONLY - to this dataset, NOT to the construct.
declination_scope_D007_item1.reversibility: REVERSIBLE. A measured non-zero route-intention disagreement rate in ANY future arm revives H8/H5a as a fundable branch.
declination_scope_D007_item1.prohibited_paraphrases: No downstream document may paraphrase this declination as H8 or H5a being inert, dead, falsified, vacuous or retired. H8's own prediction is explicitly CONDITIONAL on a non-zero disagreement rate, so an unmet antecedent in one dataset is not a generalizing claim.
declination_scope_D007_item1.registry_state: H5 and H3 remain "untested". H8 and H5a remain unregistered PROPOSALS under registry/hypotheses.json proposed_loop1 with no status at all. The registry is untouched by this analysis.
declination_scope_D007_item1.also_unmeasured: ties were reached 0/80, so the HOLD tie-break - which critiques/escalation_conditions_skeptic.md F8 argues IS the mechanism - is UNMEASURED, not validated.
